title: anatomy_result
description: What one solver run solved: per pose, the skin on its fixed topology and the skin's stretch along its edges and face diagonals, with the body parameter set, the poses and the solver that produced them. Written by the solver, read by the bake (REFACTOR/ANATOMY_EXCHANGE.md). It carries its own poses and body values, since a solver adds poses no run lists (adaptive sampling) and a result must state what it is the skin of.

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, by its `$id`: the last path segment names the file in husk's schema/ directory, and schema_version says which version of it (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "The contract header").

schema_version.description: Version of the anatomy family's schemas this document conforms to (REFACTOR/ANATOMY_EXCHANGE.md invariant 6).

subject.description: The result, by the name the solver gave it (usually its run's).

space.description: Units and axes of every value in the document.

definition.description: What the per-pose arrays are over.

coordinates.description: The order of every pose's values, as in a run.

skin.description: The skin tissue the per-vertex, per-edge and per-diagonal arrays are over: the referenced anatomy's one skin tissue, in its order. Its counts are the anatomy's, stated here so a reader holding only the result can size its arrays; validate-bundle checks them against the anatomy.

tissue.description: The skin tissue's id in the anatomy.

diagonal_count.description: Its faces' diagonals in all: n (n - 3) / 2 per face of n corners, 2 per quad.

selection.description: The body the poses were solved for.

body.description: The body parameter set solved with: every value the solver used that differs from the parameter's rest value.

references.description: The anatomy solved (required), and the run that asked for it when there was one.

solver.description: Which solver produced the poses, so two results can be told apart and a bake can say what it was fitted to.

name.description: The solver program, e.g. mantlecore's anatomy_sim.

version.description: The program's revision, e.g. a commit.

method.description: The method that solved the tissue, e.g. vbd or newton_reference.

settings.description: Every setting that changes the solved positions (material, tolerances, iteration caps), as the solver prints it.

value.description: Its value as text, with its unit where it has one.

fit_reference.description: What the poses' fit_error is measured against (e.g. the reference solver and its settings); required when any pose has a fit_error.

id.description: The pose's name, unique among the poses: a requested pose's id in the run.

origin.description: Whether the run asked for the pose or the solver added it (adaptive sampling near limits).

values.description: One value per entry of definition.coordinates, in that order: the pose solved.

converged.description: Whether the solve reached its tolerance; a pose that didn't is kept so the bake can see it and skip it.

skin_positions.description: The posed skin, f32 x 3 per skin vertex, metres, in the anatomy's vertex order.

edge_stretch.description: Stretch per skin edge, f32 x 1, in the anatomy's edge order: posed length / rest length (1 = rest, below 1 compression). Measured on edges and diagonals rather than at a face centre, so no face is split and no diagonal is picked; strain follows by the edge_metric_strain rule (REFACTOR/ANATOMY_EXCHANGE.md).

diagonal_stretch.description: Stretch per face diagonal, f32 x 1: face by face, each face's diagonals in corner-pair order (corners i < j not adjacent, i ascending, then j; a quad's are 0-2, then 1-3); posed length / rest length.

fit_error.description: Distance per skin vertex from solver.fit_reference's position, f32 x 1, metres; absent when the pose has no reference.
